test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2.
solution: The correct answer is '**operation**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**operation**'. • It means 'the fact of operating or being active (संचालन या सक्रिय होने का तथ्य)'. • *Example: There are several reactors of the type in **operation** (= working) at the moment.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.** **Correct Passage:__** *New cycle routes have been built in and around the centre of Birmingham and speed limits have been reduced on selected roads. The scheme has now been in **operation** for a year and has been hailed as a (3) ______ success. Since the new speed limits were (4) ______, the number of accidents in the area have fallen (5) ______*. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **activity**: a situation in which there is a lot of action or movement. (सक्रियता, क्रियाशीलता; गतिविधियों से पूर्ण स्थिति) • **process**: a series of actions that you do for a particular purpose. (किसी विशेष प्रयोजन से की गई क्रियाओं की शृंखला) • **agency**: a business that provides a particular service. (कोई विशेष सेवा प्रदान करने वाला व्‍यवसाय; एजेंसी) 159:T7f6, The correct answer is '**great**'.
